purpose: Read-only qualification of one completed staging-records-plan Tour through the normal Tours library and detail reader.

records_plan.creation_key_binding: keys.tour is retained as a plan reference only; it is not an API receipt or proof of a successful create call
records_plan.tour_receipt: must be absent; this plan version has no receipts.tour
records_plan.source_binding: release equals the actual App/CARR source pair supplied by the bounded runner

source_pair.app: 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters read from the current staging /app-release

fixture_binding.purpose: Match the synthetic fixture row identities to the normal API detail. This binding is not authority, an approval, a route receipt, or a CARR event.

readback.purpose: One independent fresh read before opening the library item and another after the UI observation; route-version identity and excluded-stop identity must remain stable.
required: detail.routes contains exactly one unaccepted manual route version
detail.routes[0].stops and detail.stops each contain exactly fixture_binding.excluded_stop_id
the matching stop property_id equals fixture_binding.synthetic_property_id
the matching stop is excluded with null route_sequence and route_label
the matching stop access_coordinate_status is unknown
property name and address facts are null or absent
stop location coordinates are null or absent
routing provider and routing rights receipt are null or absent
if owner or created_by is present, it equals the authenticated session actor slug

ui.title: #detail-title
expected: no external, map, telephone, or geo navigation link
ui.interaction_boundary: Click only the existing Tour library button. Do not follow Edit itinerary or any route editor, acceptance, map, or navigation control.
ui.network_boundary: This qualifier performs GET reads and tolerates only exact named App shell read-only MCP calls during its interaction; every other non-GET browser request refuses.
